parentGraphRule: Case-sensitive depth-first lookup among already inserted nodes, checking the root/self before descendants; first match; absent name uses scene root; insert before reading child body.
ordinaryMatrixBranch: Local times parent in native D3DX row-vector convention; the corresponding Three/Blender column-matrix product is parentWorld times local. Root transform must be retained, including non-identity roots.

typedLocalDestinations.ModelData: D4 initialized identity; typed transform sampler binding and ordinary branch source are established, loaded flags/runtime clip choice are not.
typedLocalDestinations.Bone: BC initialized identity; typed transform sampler binding and ordinary branch source are established, loaded flags/runtime clip choice are not.
typedLocalDestinations.SceneGroup: Base-node ordinary TRS plus parent rule with A2/A3 exceptions; no replacement by identity if the root has a transform.
typedLocalDestinations.SkyDirect1: Not qualified for native transform/render parity.
typedLocalDestinations.BoneSystem: Not qualified for native typed transform parity.

rawAffineWarning: Raw affine preservation is an authoring/source fidelity guarantee, not certification of D3DX decomposition/recomposition, reflection/shear handling, sampler timing or final rendered world placement.
limits: Authoring scenes may use a declared raw-local static pose while preserving the exact original source buffers and collision sidecars.
Do not claim automatic native clip selection or loaded-node flags from constructors alone.
Do not emulate AC modifiers, CD camera branches, A2/A3 overrides or dynamic destruction by replacing them with the ordinary branch without qualification.
Native collision categories and query masks remain separate; all oct candidates are retained in version-2 sidecars, without automatic Box/Shape/Sphere solid conversion.
